# Kerala Home Design and Floor Plans

> A comprehensive resource for contemporary and traditional Kerala home designs featuring 10,000+ dream houses with floor plans, architectural styles, and design guidance.

Kerala Home Design specializes in residential architecture across multiple styles including modern, contemporary, tropical, and colonial designs. The site provides detailed floor plans, design galleries, and expert guides on home construction, interior features, and building regulations specific to Kerala.

## Key Topics

- Kerala architecture
- Floor plans
- Contemporary house design
- Modern home design
- 3-bedroom designs
- Tropical design
- Architectural styles
- Elevation designs
- Traditional-modern fusion
- Residential architecture
- Home automation
- Energy-efficient design
- Colonial style
- Budget homes
- Luxury homes
